messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: ur5e-manual, p. 106

9. End Effector Integration Payload This feature allows the robot to help set the correct Payload and Center of Gravity (CoG). Estimation Using the 1. In the Installation Tab, under General, select Payload. Payload 2. On the Payload screen, tap Measure. Estimation 3. In the Payload Estimation Wizard tap Next. Wizard 4. Follow the steps in the Payload Estimation Wizard to set the four positions. Setting the four positions requires moving the robot arm into four different positions. The load of the payload is measured at each position. 5. Once all measurements are complete, you can verify the result and tap Finish. NOTICE Follow the these guidelines for best Payload Estimation results: • Ensure the TCP positions are as different as possible from each other Copyright © 2009–2025 by Universal Robots A/S. All rights reserved. • Perform the measurements within a short timespan • Avoid pulling on the tool and/or attached payload before and during estimation • Robot mounting and angle must be correctly defined in the installation UR5e 109 User Manual
